messages:
Mike (Partnerships): Heads up — Equinox onboarding is blocked. Their POs are being rejected by the marketplace portal: ERROR: merchant_alias_lookup_failed code=MV-422. Procurement says they need a marketplace merchant alias + net-30 terms before they’ll issue the commit PO. Demo scheduled for next Tue, this is now urgent.

Lina (Legal): Do we have their signed MSA? Any contract redlines from EQX?

Raj (Sales): They signed standard MSA but requested a reseller addendum and a custom remit-to on invoices. I flagged to finance yesterday.

Taylor (Finance): Net-30 request requires vendor onboarding completed (W9 + EIN + credit check). We can make a provisional allowance but need docs. OpsBilling, can you confirm error details?

OpsBilling Bot: Saw MV-422 in the logs for vendor EQX-5543 at 2026-03-20T21:42:13Z. Portal returns: 'merchant id not authorized for PO format v2'. Manual alias creation possible but needs partner_signing_contact + tax docs.

CSM_John: EQX rep says the portal shows: "merchant id not authorized" and the partner can't choose invoice remittance. They sent a screenshot in DM.

Mike (Partnerships): Screenshot link: https://redwood-internal/eqx/screenshots/IMG_2234.png — EQX expects onboarding to be done today.

deploy-bot: FYI last schema deploy touching merchant alias validation: release/portal-schema v2 @ 2026-03-20T02:14:07Z. No rollbacks currently.

Marco (Eng): Quick triage — the v2 validation added a strict merchant_id->billing_entity crosscheck. If EQX used an alternate billing_entity string (e.g., "EQX-NA" vs "EQX-NA-LLC") the alias lookup can fail. I can push a targeted relax/compat check for that mapping but need ops to confirm acceptable risk.

Lina (Legal): Don't roll back validation globally. Approve a manual interim alias for Equinox only, with written confirmation that it's provisional and won't set precedent. I will draft a one-page amendment for the provisional alias + payment holdback clause.

Taylor (Finance): Finance approves provisional alias for the demo if we put PO funds on hold until W9/EIN are uploaded and credit check clears. We need a signed ack from EQX.

Mike (Partnerships): Action items: 1) OpsBilling creates provisional merchant alias for EQX-5543 (mark as provisional) 2) CSM_John / Raj get W9 + partner signing contact + remit-to details from EQX 3) Marco to implement a targeted compatibility fallback and run smoke tests 4) Lina to draft the amendment language for provisional alias + holdback. ETA: 24h. @Raj (Sales) please coordinate with EQX rep. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Raj (Sales): On it — intro + docs request sent to EQX rep (cc'd legal & finance). Will update thread when they respond.

OpsBilling Bot: Creating provisional alias record now (alias_id=prov-EQX-5543). Tagging as provisional_pend_w9. Will not accept live invoicing until docs ingested.

Mike (Partnerships): Thanks. Please ping when alias is live so I can unblock the demo slot. Also Marco, if the fallback looks safe please push the hotfix to staging and coordinate smoke with Ops.

Marco (Eng): Will do. Hotfix branch created, will run tests in staging after alias is present. ETA 6-8 hours after alias created.

Lina (Legal): Drafting amendment now, will share for review in this thread.

CSM_John: EQX replied — W9 and signed contact attached to email. Raj forwarded to finance.

Taylor (Finance): Got the W9. Starting credit check.

Mike (Partnerships): Great progress. Keep updates short here. If anything blocks the provisional alias creation, escalate to me immediately.

Raj (Sales): EQX confirmed they accept provisional holdback. I'll coordinate the final PO flow after alias active.

Mike (Partnerships): Closing loop — provisional alias created, Marco kickoff, legal drafting amendment. Demo stay is tentatively green. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
